summary: Inspected all 243 changed/added files in this Kestrel C library / floats / maps unit. 158 are `.sys/*@useless-runes.lsp` certify-book rune-usage profiling sidecars under books/kestrel/c/atc/ (+ support/, symbolic-execution-rules/), books/kestrel/c/language/ (+ implementation-environments/), books/kestrel/c/syntax/ (+ tests/), books/kestrel/c/transformation/ (+ command-line/, json-rpc/, tests/, utilities/), books/kestrel/floats/, and books/kestrel/xml/, the same declaration-free build artifact class already excluded elsewhere in this source, so I excluded all 158.
